scope: Debian 13 ARM64 VM installer Phase 0 (read-only plan inspection) and Phase 1 (non-root DESTDIR staging with --without-service-manager --without-accounts) using current committed source. No persistent host change; no account, mask, enable, daemon-reload, start or reboot. Not a product deployment and not runtime admission.

interpreter.construction: Throwaway ordinary unpacked CPython 3.13.5 venv (python3.13 -m venv --without-pip) under the operator home. Site-packages hold copies of dbus_next 0.2.3 and PyYAML 6.0.3 (with dist-info) from the existing conformance venv, the azazel_nexus and azazel_nexus_runtime packages from the verified 9d9f7bd archive, and the previously reviewed native backend.
interpreter.why_not_existing_venv: The existing conformance venv carries an editable install of an older 2026-10-13 source tree; the stager deliberately ignores .pth and system site-packages (tools/stage_runtime_entrypoints.py:120-127), so it cannot stage current source. The existing venv was not modified.
interpreter.native_backend_note: Same reviewed artifact pinned by tools/qualify_bootstrap_deadline_sandbox.py NATIVE_SHA256; verified by sha256 before copy. Import-only load check; no timer armed.
interpreter.not_a_production_venv: This is a staging fixture interpreter, not reviewed production provisioning and not admitted by the installed-files manifest.

persistent_side_effects_requiring_approv.phase2_files_and_accounts: sudo env PYTHON=<venv> sh packaging/install.sh --without-service-manager : writes /usr/libexec/azazel, /etc/azazel, /var/lib/azazel, /lib/systemd/system*, /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d and creates 7 system accounts + azazel-operator group (packaging/install.sh:180-252)
persistent_side_effects_requiring_approv.phase3_service_manager: sudo env PYTHON=<venv> sh packaging/install.sh : additionally daemon-reload, masks 7 operational units in /etc/systemd/system, runs systemd-tmpfiles, and `systemctl enable azazel-activated.service` for the NEXT BOOT (packaging/install.sh:261-283)
persistent_side_effects_requiring_approv.phase4_start_controller: systemctl start azazel-activated : root controller; documented to report a failed Type=notify start on a clean fail-closed refusal
persistent_side_effects_requiring_approv.phase5_reboot: exercises the persistent enable; requires a VM snapshot and console access
persistent_side_effects_requiring_approv.rollback: no uninstall script exists; prefer VM snapshot revert
